description: Planning Framework for a Climate-Resilient Economy is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA, U.S. Environmental Protection Agency; Rhode Island Division of Planning; Town of North Kingstown, Rhode Island. The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and the Rhode Island Division of Planning developed this framework to help communities assess their economic vulnerability to climate change. A pilot community (North Kingstown, Rhode Island) tested and refined the framework, and the University of Rhode Island's Coastal Resources Center assisted in this effort. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Changing Seasons, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Economy, Property, Transportation and Mobility. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
